title: Design System: Bộ lọc cổ phiếu đa yếu tố

change-up.name: Pale Change Blue
change-up.role: rank-rise deltas and the newly-ranked tag

display.purpose: Selected stock symbol (26px) and score (30px) in the detail panel only.

headline.purpose: Metric values in the status strip; 17px at <=560px.

body.purpose: Default text with tabular figures; method prose at 1.6 line-height, max 75ch.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, chips, legend, metric captions, chart titles.

chart-label.purpose: SVG axis and bar labels, fixed 11px because charts are drawn at container pixel width.

shadows.name: tab-lift
shadows.purpose: VN30 badge in the top bar.

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.purpose: Stacked total bar and factor bar width changes; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: loading-dim
motion.purpose: Table and side column dim to .55 while data reloads.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Controls collapse into the 'Bộ lọc và thời điểm' disclosure; icon-only CSV; full-width group tabs.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Workspace becomes one column; metrics 2x2; table scrolls horizontally.

breakpoints.name: half-screen
breakpoints.purpose: Side panel fixed at 340px; factor columns hidden (901-1180px) and the stacked bar widens to 200px.

narrative.overview:
The category standard played straight: a dark Vietnamese stock dashboard at the finish of SSI iBoard and FireAnt/Simplize, built to sit open beside the price board for a whole trading session. The user chose this world over any novelty direction; its job is to look exactly as trustworthy as the tools brokers already use, then do one thing those tools do not: show why each stock ranks where it does, inside the row.

Density is a working-desk density: 46px table rows, 34px controls, 12–14px text, tabular figures everywhere. Depth comes from tonal steps of a near-black blue ground and 1px seams, not from shadows. Colour is spent with discipline in three separate jobs that never borrow from each other: one blue accent for selection and focus, four factor hues that encode the score split, and market green/red/amber only where price moves or data is stale.

Everything is offline: system UI sans, drawn 16px line icons from an inline SVG sprite, inline SVG charts, no web fonts, no CDN, and a CSP that forbids inline style attributes.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black blue ground with tonal surfaces and 1px seams; flat, no decorative shadow.
Three colour vocabularies with fixed jobs: accent (selection), factor palette (score composition), market colours (price and staleness).
Every ranking row carries a contribution-stacked total bar plus four factor percentile bars.
Exceptions speak, valid states stay silent; run-wide notes appear once.
Segoe UI system stack with tabular figures; Vietnamese copy throughout.

rules.name: The Three Vocabularies Rule
rules.body: Blue accent means "selected or focused", factor hues mean "this factor's share", green/red/amber mean "price moved or data is stale". A colour never crosses into another vocabulary's job.

rules.name: The Market Colour Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only where a price moves or a connection/status is stated. Scores are never coloured green or red; a high score is shown by bar length and the factor palette.

rules.name: The Factor Constancy Rule
rules.body: A factor's hue is identical in the table, detail panel, chart, legend and brand mark. Factor colour is applied by class (c-momentum, c-liquidity, c-foreign, c-imbalance) or the matching hex in SVG, never improvised.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number is set in tabular figures and right-aligned in numeric columns, so scores, ranks and times never jitter as data updates.

rules.name: The Split Survives Rule
rules.body: When width forces columns out, the factor columns go first and the contribution-stacked bar grows to carry the factor split. "Why this rank" is never dropped from the row.

rules.name: The Seam Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Panels separate from the ground by a tone step and a 1px seam. No drop shadows on panels, cards or menus.

rules.name: The Change Is Not a Market Move Rule
rules.text: The Change Is Not a Market Move Rule. Rank and score changes against an earlier moment are not price moves: a rise uses Pale Change Blue (change-up) with an up chevron, a fall uses Tertiary Ink with a down chevron, "mới" marks a stock newly ranked. Never green or red.

dos: Do keep the three colour vocabularies separate: accent #3B82F6 for selection/focus/primary, the factor palette for score composition, #16C784/#FF5C66/#F0B90B only for price movement, connection and staleness.
Do show every ranked row with its contribution-stacked total bar and, where width allows, four factor percentile bars.
Do keep valid rows silent in the status column; give an exception a dot plus a short Vietnamese label.
Do state run-wide reasons and warnings once, in the notice banner or legend note.
Do label synthetic data with the amber chip whenever it is shown.
Do set every number in tabular figures and draw icons as 16px line icons (1.6 stroke) from the inline sprite.
Do apply factor colours and bar widths through classes and the CSSOM; the CSP forbids inline style attributes.
Do draw charts at container pixel width so chart labels stay 11px.
donts: Don't colour scores green or red; score strength is bar length in factor hues.
Don't stack warning boxes over the ranking or repeat a run-wide note on every row.
Don't add drop shadows to panels; separate with tone and a 1px seam.
Don't load web fonts, icon fonts or CDN assets; the build runs offline.
Don't fall back to the Streamlit arrangement of a form-control sidebar, stacked info boxes and one generic bar chart.
Don't drop the factor split at narrow widths; hide factor columns and widen the stacked bar instead.
